plain_text:
When COVID-19 vaccines arrived in Kenya, many people were unsure
about them. So much misinformation was circulating in communities
that they did not trust the vaccine. Working closely with political,
administrative and community leaders, WHO set out to explain how the
vaccines and other prevention measures, such as masks, work and how
they protect people from the disease. In Kisumu County, concerted
communication and vaccination outreach over 10 days helped quintuple
demand for the vaccine, and the number of people vaccinated increased
from 896 to 4,338.
